prompts.text: A stylish woman walks down a Tokyo street filled with warm neon lighting, cinematic, 35mm film
A wide waterfall cascades into a clear mountain lake surrounded by green forest. Mist drifts above the water. A stationary camera records the natural scene in daylight.
A fluffy giant panda dances playfully on a wooden stage, swaying its body and waving its paws. The camera slowly moves closer. Soft warm lighting, detailed fur.
A small red toy car drives from left to right across a white tabletop, passing blue and yellow blocks. A close-up stationary camera shows the moving wheels and reflections.

capture_branch: conditional, verified against actual text embeddings
dominant_pair: argmax_f E_tokens(norm(q_f)) * E_tokens(norm(k_f)), restricted to the requested RoPE axis, recomputed separately per prompt/step/layer/head
scatter: every video token, one selected 2D pair per head and axis, pre/post RoPE on identical token positions
centers: float32 mean of full normalized pre-RoPE Q/K over all video tokens, separately per prompt/step/layer/head
logits: full 128D head, all 64 pairs, every query and every key sharing the other two coordinates, both signed offset directions, including self
logit_plot: mean and population standard deviation of measured logits across all query/key pairs at each signed offset; mean center prediction on the same pairs
correlation: Pearson across all same-axis-line keys for each individual query; distribution and mean across all queries; constant rows undefined, not zero
concentration_distribution: 12 heads of this one layer/prompt/step/axis; Q/K selected-pair pre/post MRL; all pair values also retained
pooling: no prompt/step/layer/head pooling in primary figures; any later summary states its aggregation explicitly
